extracted.name: Butternut Pie
extracted.description: Pie, there’s always something to be thankful for. #GoldenApron23
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 375*. Press pie crusts into pie plates.
Blend remaining ingredients until smooth. Divide into prepared crusts.
Bake in preheated oven for 35-40 minutes or until pies are set in the center.
One butternut squash will make 4 pies usually.
